judge.what_is_spun: Aluminium, merchant power, oil & gas and iron ore undertakings of Vedanta Limited, demerged into four separate resulting companies
judge.reason: Each business has distinct risk, competition, financial profiles and return ratios, attracting different investors; demerger lends enhanced focus, creates independent global-scale pure-play companies, enables sharper capital market access and unlocks shareholder value
judge.insiders: Promoter and promoter group held 2,204,867,749 shares, voting 100% in favour. Every shareholder gets 1 share of each new company; "Other than this, there will be no change in the overall shareholding structure."
judge.hidden_value: Four pure-play entities each with "$100 billion" potential; residual Vedanta keeps 63.4% of Hindustan Zinc, Zinc International and technology businesses as group incubator. Lenders preferred Base Metals retained for "optimal balancing of debt allocation". NCLT found TSPL concealed Rs 1,251 crore SEPCO dues, possibly negative post-demerger net worth.
judge.selling_pressure_why: Shareholders get one share of each of four companies in distinct industries "capable of attracting a different set of investors"
judge.listing_timeline: Management said on August 6, 2024 the demerger "will get done on or before 31st of March 2025" and "has the ability to get listed as and when we have the approval"; on March 28, 2025 the Board extended the timeline for fulfilment of conditions precedent "from March 31, 2025 to September 30, 2025"
judge.read_next: The Scheme's clause 39 conditions and debt-allocation/net-worth figures per resulting company; status of TSPL's appeal against the March 4, 2025 rejection
judge.quote: I envision that each of the four newly demerged companies has the potential to grow into a $100 billion company.

judge.what_is_spun: Madura Fashion & Lifestyle (MFL) western wear brands business, demerged into Aditya Birla Lifestyle Brands Limited
judge.reason: MFL's distinctive profile and established model suit a separately listed entity, allowing sharper strategic focus, better control, operational rationalisation, and unlocking value through price discovery of individual entities for existing shareholders.
judge.insiders: All demerged-company shareholders get identical shareholdings in both companies. Promoter group entity Pilani subscribed Rs 1,297.50 crore preferential issue at Rs 317.75, a ~18% premium; ESOPs replaced with ABLBL options adjusted for share exchange ratio.
judge.hidden_value: MFL is the proven, cash-generating half: Rs 5,925 crore 9M revenue, 16.5% Q3 EBITDA margin, 'consistent revenue growth, profitability, strong free cash flows and high return on capital', starting with only Rs 700 crore debt, while remaining ABFRL's Ethnic and Others segment lost Rs 368 crore.
judge.selling_pressure_why: Spun entity is roughly half of group revenue and the profitable cash generator; all shareholders receive identical holdings in both companies.

Feb 17, 2025 call: demerger 'is progressing well and set for completion within the next 2, 3 months. The NCLT hearing is scheduled in third week of March 2025.' NCLT sanctioned the Scheme March 27, 2025; actual listing date not stated.

judge.quote: The distinctive profile and established business model of the MFL Business makes it suitable to be housed in a separately listed entity, allowing sharper strategic focus in pursuit of its independent value creation trajectory.

judge.read_next: Entity-wise/business-wise financials of DMSL and MAL promised post-demerger, showing debt split and TAN standalone earnings.

judge.what_is_spun: Quess's Global Technology Solutions platform — BPM services, customer lifecycle management, HR outsourcing and InsurTech — into Digitide Solutions Limited
judge.reason: Businesses are distinct in technology, customers and risk; separation gives sharper management focus, independent growth and capital-allocation strategies, de-risks businesses from one another, and unlocks value through better price discovery.
judge.insiders: Mirror shareholding — promoters 56.6%, public 43.4% in each entity; 1 new share per Quess share. Vested ESOPs transfer to resulting companies, unvested cancelled with fresh allotment. Gurmeet Chahal hired as CEO to lead Digitide.
judge.hidden_value: GTS is the group's margin engine: 9MFY25 revenue ₹1,881cr (12% of consolidated) but EBITDA ₹327cr of ₹581cr at 17.4% margin versus 3.7% consolidated. FY24 revenue ₹2.3k cr, EBITDA ₹425cr, 17% revenue CAGR FY21-24, rising international mix.
judge.selling_pressure_why: Small unlisted entity distributed 1:1 to 99,413 shareholders; BPM/tech business unrelated to parent's workforce-management staffing franchise.
judge.listing_timeline: Investor presentation dated January 29, 2025 shows "Q1 FY26 — Application with Stock Exchanges, Corporate Actions with NSDL/CDSL – Listing and trading on stock exchanges" and "target demerger by Q1FY26"; on January 30, 2025 CFO said "we should be able to see all 3 companies demerged and listed by Q1 of next financial year". Scheme became effective March 31, 2025 (appointed date April 1, 2024), with record date "to be informed in due course" per March 18, 2025 letter.
judge.read_next: Digitide's Information Memorandum / abridged-prospectus disclosures required by BSE-NSE observation letters — standalone assets, liabilities, net worth, revenue.
judge.quote: Digitide Solutions (Resulting Company- 1), will offer a comprehensive suite of solutions including BPM Services, Insurtech and HRO.

Scheme became effective March 31, 2025 (appointed date April 1, 2024), with record date "to be informed in due course" per March 18, 2025 letter.

judge.what_is_spun: Tata Motors' Commercial Vehicles Business, with its related investments, demerged into TML Commercial Vehicles Limited (later renamed Tata Motors Limited)
judge.reason: Distinctive profiles and business models of the CV and PV businesses suit separately listed entities: sharper strategic focus, better control, greater agility, accountability, clear capital allocation, and value unlocked through price-discovery.
judge.insiders: Promoters hold 100% of TMLCV pre-scheme, 41.22% indicative post-scheme; shareholding mirrors TML with common promoters (Tata Sons). No cash consideration. AGM approved Share-based Long Term Incentive Scheme 2024.
judge.hidden_value: CV business carried ~99% of TML standalone total income (Rs.73,116.64 crore FY24) yet ~60% of assets; residual TMPV keeps PV, EV (TPEM) and JLR investments. CV posted ROCE ~38-40% and double-digit EBITDA.
judge.selling_pressure_why: 1:1 mirror shareholding, both entities listed on BSE and NSE; CV is ~99% of standalone income and ~60% of assets, not a small spin.

judge.reason: Diversified business requires reorientation for greater focus on each business and operational efficiency; segregation enables independent growth, industry-specific regulation, efficient capital use, and potential to unlock value by drawing focused investors; merger simplifies promoter holding structure
judge.insiders: Promoters 61.01% pre-scheme; post-amalgamation hold 60.27% of IGL directly rather than through Kashipur Holdings, and 60.27% of both EBL and ISL. Benefit to promoter group from restructuring: "NIL."
judge.hidden_value: Spirits and Biofuel is 78.15% of FY24 turnover (Rs 6,188.82 crore, 14.4% 9MFY25 EBITDA margin) with premium IMFL/Amrut, captive ENA and quota-based country liquor hidden inside a "green chemical" company; chemicals Rs 1,079 crore at 13.6%; Rs 1,200 crore term loan unallocated
judge.selling_pressure_why: EBL is tiny — 3.16% of turnover, 1-for-3 ratio with fractional entitlements; spirits/biofuel is a different industry from chemicals
judge.listing_timeline: On 6 February 2025 CFO said "the demerger will be effective from 1st April, 26" and "we will take about 12 months to 15 months in getting all the formalities relating to demerger done" including SEBI, lender and NCLT approvals; "all the three companies will be listed on the stock exchange" (BSE and NSE)
judge.read_next: SBI-pending allocation of the Rs 1,200 crore term loan and working capital across the three entities

judge.reason: Scheme described as "Composite Scheme of Arrangement to unlock shareholders value"; management said digital marketing will be decoupled from payments given regulations, and the dot-triple-O top level domain is a significant, unmonetized, high-margin opportunity

judge.selling_pressure_why: 1 Odigma share per 89 Infibeam shares; 0.07% of cost basis; fractional entitlements consolidated and sold in market by a trustee

December 12, 2024"

judge.reason: Creation of OneSource, India's first specialty pharma pure-play CDMO, integrating Stelis' Biologics CDMO, SteriScience's Complex Injectables and Strides' Soft Gelatine; simplifies structure so each entity leverages core strengths

judge.what_is_spun: 26% residual equity shareholding in four transmission SPV associate companies, transferred to POWERGRID Infrastructure Investment Trust (PGInvIT)
judge.reason: Filing states only that the sale is governed by Share Purchase Agreements of April 2021; Feb 2025 call: "the initial InvIT was found to monetise the commissioned assets".
judge.insiders: "POWERGRID is Sponsor of PGInvIT and holds 15% of its Units"; PGInvIT acts through Investment Manager POWERGRID Unchahar Transmission Limited, a wholly owned POWERGRID subsidiary.
judge.hidden_value: Rs 506.63 crore cash for stakes contributing Rs 68.09 crore, 0.144% of FY24 consolidated income; independent-valuer, arm's-length price. Feb 2025 call reveals NMP guidelines now block further asset transfers to PGInvIT, so monetisation route shifted to securitisation.
judge.selling_pressure_why: Immaterial size (0.144% of consolidated income); no new company or shares listed, only an existing residual stake sold.
judge.listing_timeline: not stated; no new entity lists — "Sale completed on 30.12.2024" and the Companies "ceased to be the Associate Companies of POWERGRID w.e.f. the date of transfer"; buyer PGInvIT is already listed (05.02.2025 call: "it raised funds at IPO around ₹100. Today, the share price is nearing ₹80")
judge.read_next: The letter dt. 06.11.2024 and the Independent Valuer's valuation of the four Associate Companies.
judge.quote: With this, POWERGRID holds Nil shareholding in the Companies and accordingly, the Companies have ceased to be the Associate Companies of POWERGRID w.e.f. the date of transfer.

judge.what_is_spun: Affordable housing finance — smaller-ticket home loans and MSME LAP — housed in wholly-owned subsidiary Sammaan Finserve Limited
judge.reason: Separate company dedicated to affordable housing "opens up the opportunity for value unlocking, as peer companies in this sector trade at 3x to 4x book multiples"; non-overlapping, viable business models
judge.insiders: "promoter-less, board run, professionally managed, diversely held"; erstwhile promoter fully exited, top five institutional investors own ~25%; SFL wholly owned by SCL, no separate insider stake stated
judge.hidden_value: SFL: ~Rs 3,000 crore net worth, geared 1:1 vs peers ~4x, Rs 6,100 crore retail AUM, needs no fresh capital, targets 5%+ ROA; peers at 3-4x book while parent carries Rs 27,000 crore legacy book
judge.selling_pressure_why: No shares distributed to shareholders; SFL stays a wholly-owned subsidiary pending monetization to a strategic partner
judge.listing_timeline: not stated — on the Nov 15, 2024 call management said monetization "is on our agenda" but "I can't put an exact time line", to "move forward in the course of the next few quarters" after the leadership team and RBI de-subsidiarization
judge.read_next: Sammaan Finserve standalone financials and RBI de-subsidiarization status; note NCLT scheme on file is an amalgamation, not a demerger
judge.quote: Building up a separate company to dedicatedly focus on this business also opens up the opportunity for value unlocking, as peer companies in this sector trade at 3x to 4x book multiples.

judge.what_is_spun: Nothing spun off — three cement subsidiaries absorbed into parent JK Lakshmi Cement; UCWL ceases separate listing
demerged_business_names: JK Lakshmi Cement Limited (JKLC / Amalgamated Company / Applicant Company 1)
Udaipur Cement Works Limited (UCWL / Amalgamating Company 1 / Applicant Company 2)
Hansdeep Industries & Trading Company Limited (HITCL / Amalgamating Company 2)
Hidrive Developers and Industries Private Limited (HDIPL / Hi Drive Developers and Industries Limited / Amalgamating Company 3)
Cementitious Materials (the company's only business segment)
judge.reason: Consolidate four fragmented cement entities into one business-focused entity: value unlocking, simplified group structure, operational, logistics and procurement synergies, and optimum market multiple valuation instead of discounted multiple with fragmented capacities
judge.insiders: Promoter & Promoter Group goes 46.34% to 45.12% post-scheme, shares 5,45,25,922 to 5,60,14,101; promoters declared interested and voted 100% in favour; two UCWL public shareholders classified under JKLC promoter group
judge.hidden_value: Reverse of a spin-off: consolidation surfaces UCWL's just-commissioned 2.5 MTPA grinding capacity still ramping (57% utilisation, targeted 65% FY26) and group leverage — consolidated net debt/EBITDA 2.43x versus 0.54x standalone — now wholly on JKLC
judge.selling_pressure_why: Documents give no size or index detail; only ~64.7 lakh new JKLC shares (4 per 100 UCWL) go to UCWL minority holders
judge.listing_timeline: 31 July 2024 filing: 'once the Scheme becomes effective, it is proposed to list the equity shares of the Company issued as consideration for the proposed Scheme on BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Limited'; 8 November 2024 call: merger expected 'anywhere in the second half of the calendar year 2025', NCLT taking 8-9 months; 7 February 2025 call: NCLT 'might take about eight, nine months', targeting end of calendar 2025
judge.read_next: NCLT Jaipur Bench sanction order and record date, plus UCWL's standalone debt folding into JKLC's post-scheme balance sheet
judge.quote: The Scheme shall also simplify the group structure and make it more commercially meaningful to have one combined entity focused in the business of cement and cement products.

judge.reason: "deeper integration of Kiddopia into the Nazara ecosystem, paving the way for operational synergies and global growth opportunities" and "bringing core gaming business into the parent entity to provide for fungible cash flows"
judge.insiders: Paper Boat is wholly owned by Nazara, so no separate entity stake. Promoter and promoter group held 8.79% of Nazara pre-preferential issue, 8.31% post; Nitish Mittersain is Joint MD & CEO
judge.hidden_value: Kiddopia is cash-generative: Q3FY25 revenue INR 47.6 crores, EBITDA INR 12.0 crores, 25.2% margin, yet subscribers fell from 273,249 to 232,295 and CPT rose to $43.6; merger makes these cash flows fungible at the listed parent
judge.selling_pressure_why: Amalgamation into the listed parent, not a demerger; no new listed entity and no shares issued, since Paper Boat is wholly owned
judge.listing_timeline: not stated; the documents say only that "the appointed date of the scheme would be October 1, 2024" and "Application for merger with the parent filed on 24th Jan 2025" (investor presentation filed February 13, 2025)
judge.read_next: The Scheme of Arrangement itself as filed with the exchanges, plus Paper Boat Apps' standalone revenue and EBITDA

judge.what_is_spun: No business separated; the schemes amalgamate subsidiaries Sanghi Industries and Penna Cement Industries into Ambuja Cements.
judge.reason: Both companies in the same line of business; amalgamation lets the Transferee absorb operations more effectively, with better resource utilisation, reduced overheads, cost savings, economies of scale, rationalisation of multiple group entities, increasing shareholders' value.
judge.insiders: Ambuja promoter/promoter group 1,66,33,81,052 shares, 67.53% pre-arrangement, 67.18% post Scheme 1, unchanged under Scheme 2; Adani family infused INR20,000 crore warrants to 70.3%; certain Sanghi promoter-group shareholders reclassified to 'public'.
judge.hidden_value: Consolidation, not separation: Sanghi (net worth INR1,110.79 crore, 37% cement utilisation) and Penna (14 MTPA, cost 10-15% above Ambuja) absorbed into a debt-free parent holding INR8,755 crore cash and INR4,500 crore of incentives still receivable.
judge.selling_pressure_why: Only ~1.3 crore new Ambuja shares to ex-Sanghi public holders (public 32.47% to 32.82%); Penna settled in cash.
judge.option_pricing_date: Valuation Report and fairness opinion dated 17th December 2024; Record Date for Penna cash consideration not stated
judge.listing_timeline: Media release 17 December 2024: 'Subject to requisite approvals, transaction expected to be completed within 9-12 months'; Sanghi shares held by Ambuja 'shall stand cancelled and extinguished', no new entity lists; NCLT ordered Ambuja shareholder meeting on Friday, May 2, 2025 for the separate Adani Cementation scheme.
judge.read_next: Scheme explanatory statement filed with NCLT: last three years' revenue, PAT and EBITDA of Sanghi and Penna.
judge.quote: The amalgamation will lead to reduction and rationalisation of multiple entities in the group.

judge.what_is_spun: Nothing is spun off; subsidiary Cavendish Industries Ltd's tyre, tube and flap business is amalgamated into listed JK Tyre
judge.reason: Both in similar line of business; amalgamation houses all businesses in one listed company giving economies of scale, operational synergies, lower overheads, reduction in interest cost, fewer compliances, improved investor perception and enhanced shareholders' value
judge.insiders: Promoter holding falls from 50.55% to 49.31% post-scheme (public 49.45% to 50.69%); 92 JK Tyre shares per 100 CIL shares. Arun K. Bajoria is whole-time director of both companies, holding 500 shares
judge.hidden_value: Cavendish standalone: net worth Rs.1,009.71 crore on assets Rs.4,003.67 crore, quarterly turnover Rs.974.57 crore; FY24 topline Rs.3,665 crore, EBITDA margin 14.0%, PAT Rs.156 crore. Carried-forward income-tax losses not on balance sheet, usable over 1.5-2 years. Consolidated net debt Rs.4,319 crore
judge.selling_pressure_why: Only ~69 lakh new shares issued (~2.5% dilution) to Cavendish holders; no new listing, same tyre industry
judge.listing_timeline: No separate listing of a demerged entity; Appointed Date of the Scheme is 1st April 2025 and, per the 6 November 2024 call, the merger 'is expected to be completed within the next 10-12 months'
judge.read_next: Draft Scheme plus PwC share entitlement ratio report on jktyre.com; and the quantum of Cavendish's carried-forward tax losses
judge.quote: The Board of Directors of the Company on 16th September, 2024 has approved the 'Scheme of Amalgamation' with Cavendish Industries Limited, a subsidiary.

judge.insiders: Promoter and promoter group held 87,72,58,759 of 1,54,20,00,018 shares (about 57%) at the December 12, 2024 cut-off; voted 100% in favour. No incentive terms stated.
judge.hidden_value: Separation of Viacom18 leaves a Rs 476 crore/quarter news business at 2% EBITDA margin plus investments: 16.12% of Viacom18 (6.3% effective JV interest), BookMyShow 39.29%, Eenadu TV 24.5%; standalone exceptional gain Rs 3,498 crore, consolidated loss Rs 1,426 crore.
judge.selling_pressure_why: 49,50,51,499 new shares (about a third of enlarged capital) issued to TV18/E18 holders; 2,54,110 fractional shares sold in market
judge.listing_timeline: Stated November 21, 2024: "The Equity Shares of the Company shall be admitted for trading on BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Limited effective November 22, 2024"; allotment was October 25, 2024 and the Scheme became effective October 3, 2024
judge.read_next: Q3FY25 standalone results: the provisional Rs 3,498 crore exceptional gain and carrying value of the 16.12% Viacom18 stake

demerged_business_names: Aquapharm Chemicals Private Limited ("ACPL" or "Transferor Company")
Advaya Chemical Industries Limited ("ACIL" or "Transferee Company")
judge.reason: "The Transferee Company is desirous of consolidating the assets and liabilities of the Transferor Company"; combination and optimal utilisation of resources, operating efficiencies, efficient capital utilization, elimination of multiple entities, legal and regulatory compliances and reduction of administrative costs.
judge.insiders: "There will be no change in the shareholding pattern of the Company pursuant to the proposed Scheme." No shares issued as consideration. Promoters separately took 1,60,00,000 warrants at Rs 280 each (7 May 2024).
judge.hidden_value: Chemical segment assets Rs 4,373.25 crores against liabilities Rs 3,011.91 crores (31.12.2024); merger reversed Rs 554.20 crores deferred tax liability and triggered Rs 554.72 crores goodwill impairment, profit-neutral; consolidated debt-equity 1.34 versus 0.49 a year earlier.
judge.selling_pressure_why: ACPL wholly owned by ACIL; no shares issued, no change in listed entity's shareholding pattern, nothing listed.
judge.listing_timeline: not stated — no listing contemplated; the Scheme "has been made effective today i.e. 1st January, 2025" (filing dated 1st January, 2025), ACPL ceasing to exist as a separate entity
judge.read_next: The Scheme of Amalgamation and Regional Director's 6 December 2024 order; Chemical segment assets/liabilities and Advaya's Rs 550 crores NCDs.
judge.quote: The Scheme was filed with ROC on January 1, 2025, which is also considered as the effective date in term of the scheme ("Effective Date") and consequently ACPL stands amalgamated with ACIL and ACPL ceases to exist as a separate entity.

judge.selling_pressure_why: No new shares allotted, ACIL unlisted, no change in shareholding pattern; nothing new distributed to shareholders

judge.quote: As the Transferor Company and the Transferee Company operate in related businesses, the proposed amalgamation will consolidate the business of these companies into a single entity resulting in operational efficiencies, cost competitiveness and business synergies on account of economies of scale.

judge.insiders: No new entity. In the parent, promoter Essar Telecom took 47,96,163 of 92,65,215 warrants at Rs 417; KMPs Sanjeev Verma and Deepak Kumar Bansal 1,19,904 each
judge.hidden_value: No separation, so nothing revealed about a hidden business. The write-off clears Rs 107.94 crore of accumulated losses, leaving Securities Premium at Rs 137.80 crore, Capital Reserve nil, and enabling dividends and easier fund-raising
judge.selling_pressure_why: No shares are issued, distributed or cancelled; the scheme leaves shareholding pattern and share count unchanged
judge.listing_timeline: not stated — no demerged entity; the Scheme (filed June 27, 2024) says the Company's existing listing on BSE and NSE shall continue
judge.read_next: FY25 reserves note: post-reduction Securities Premium of Rs 137.80 crore and resulting dividend capacity
judge.quote: The reduction envisaged under this Scheme will not result in any change in the shareholding of the Members of the Company and would not in any way have any adverse effect on the Company's ability to honour its commitments or meet its obligations in the ordinary course of business.

judge.what_is_spun: Nothing is spun off; defunct coal-mining SPV Utkal Coal Limited is merged into parent IMFA
demerged_business_names: Utkal Coal and Power Limited (original name)
Indian Metals and Ferro Alloys Limited (Transferee Company)
judge.reason: UCL's coal block was cancelled, so it can no longer fulfil its purpose; merger makes IMFA legal owner of the compensation claim, eliminates fixed costs, simplifies structure, reduces costs, enhances shareholder value
judge.insiders: Promoters hold 31,663,712 of 53,954,106 IMFA shares; no shares issued, pattern unchanged; promoter companies' residual 20.80% UCL stake bought for INR 1 to make it wholly owned (26 June 2024)
judge.hidden_value: Reveals the compensation asset: Rs 352.90 crore final award for the cancelled Utkal-C block, of which Rs 131.52 crore and Rs 221.37 crore were ordered disbursed, against which IMFA had already impaired Rs 111.42 crore equity and Rs 5.10 crore loan
judge.selling_pressure_why: No new shares, no cash consideration, UCL shares cancelled; 'shareholding pattern of the Company remains unchanged pursuant to this Scheme'
judge.listing_timeline: No listing: UCL's equity shares are unlisted and it 'shall stand dissolved without being wound up'; Regional Director order dated 28 February 2025 made the scheme 'active from the TWENTY EIGHTH day of FEBRUARY TWO THOUSAND TWENTY FIVE' (filed 5 March 2025)
judge.read_next: Receipt status of the Rs 221.37 crore compensation and the pending Rs 63.81 crore claim before the Coal Tribunal, Talcher
judge.quote: The proposed amalgamation simplifies the corporate structure by removing an entity because the Transferor Company can no longer fulfil its original purpose.

judge.what_is_spun: Nothing separated; scheme amalgamates subsidiary Kurlon Enterprise Limited and its five subsidiaries into Sheela Foam Limited

Starship Value Chain and Manufacturing Private Limited ("SVCMPL" or "Transferor Company 5")
judge.reason: Not stated in the scheme filings; on calls management said it consolidated operations, services, sales and the corporate entity to crystallise Kurlon integration synergies and savings sooner rather than running two entities separately

judge.hidden_value: No business is released; the filings instead reveal leverage and consolidation value: Rs 725 crore unsecured NCDs, consolidated debt-equity 0.51x, Rs 1,701.72 crore intangibles, Rs 30 crore goodwill remeasurement, and Rs 100-150 crore monetisable closed Kurlon plants
judge.selling_pressure_why: No separate entity is being listed or distributed; KEL is an existing subsidiary merging into listed SFL, same industry
judge.option_pricing_date: October 16, 2024 (grant of 1,35,198 options approved; the October 29, 2024 filing states October 10, 2024); earlier grant of 11,084 options approved May 21, 2024
judge.listing_timeline: not stated (no listing of a demerged entity; as of the November 27, 2024 filing the Scheme remains subject to statutory, regulatory, shareholder and creditor approvals, and the NSE observation letter is valid six months from November 26, 2024 within which the Scheme must be submitted to NCLT)
